body:
Happy Minecraft Dungeons II release day! The Aurora Cape is now available to claim on your account by watching Minecraft Dungeons II content on either Twitch or TikTok!

As for these capes in Bedrock Cosmos, we have gone ahead and updated each Minecraft Dungeons II cape to now use its official texture! The Aurora and Slice Slayer Capes are also now available for you to try on as well!
